result.description: Compact hybrid power accessory for camping, emergency lighting, and off-grid charging. Combines a rechargeable battery pack with a dimmable lantern module, USB-C input/output, and weather-resistant housing. Designed for hikers, field crews, and travel kits rather than computing or storage use. Includes low, medium, and high illumination modes, a hanging hook, and integrated charge indicator LEDs.
result.title: Aurex TideWatch 14L Outdoor Lantern Power Bank
result.title_description: Portable lantern power bank with 14,000 mAh battery
